traits.Spider Climb: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing an ability check.
traits.Web Sense: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
traits.Web Walker: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.note: The target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 2d8 poison damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Web
actions.note: The target is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 12 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success.
